description: Partial update: pass only the fields you want to change. Plan-feature constraints from `monitor_create` apply on update too.

body.description: Request body for `http`/`keyword`. Omit to leave empty.

check_interval.description: Interval between checks in seconds. Defaults to 300 — the smallest value every plan allows. Anything shorter needs `min_check_interval_seconds` of the current plan to permit it (60 on paid plans).

confirm.description: Set to true to authorize this write/destructive call even if STATUSER_ALLOW_WRITE is not enabled in the server config. Required for one-off overrides.

heartbeat_grace_interval.description: Additional grace period (in seconds) past `check_interval` for `heartbeat` monitors.

host.description: Host to monitor: URL for http/keyword, hostname or IP for ping/tcp/dns, identifier for heartbeat, API endpoint for llm (domain, versioned base or a full method path — the method path is appended when missing).

http_method.description: HTTP method, applies to `http` and `keyword` protocols. Defaults to `head` there, as in the panel — the cheapest request that still proves the service answers.

incident_confirm_delay.description: Delay (in seconds, up to 1 hour) before an incident is opened: the service must stay down continuously for longer than this, otherwise short blips raise no incident and no alert. 0 (default) opens the incident on the first failed check. Requires `incident_debounce_enabled` on the current plan (Team).

is_blocklist_check.description: Watch whether the domain appears in the Roskomnadzor (RKN) blocklist registry. Applies to `http`/`keyword`/`dns`. Requires `blocklist_monitoring_enabled` on the current plan.

is_domain_check.description: Watch the domain registration of the host. Defaults to false for the same reason as `is_ssl_check` (`domain_monitoring_enabled`).

is_follow_redirects.description: Follow HTTP redirects. Defaults to true for `http`/`keyword` (what the panel does) and to false for the protocols where redirects mean nothing.

is_ssl_check.description: Watch the SSL certificate of the host. Defaults to false: it is a paid feature (`ssl_monitoring_enabled`), and turning it on by default would make creation fail on Free. Pass true to enable.

keyword.description: Substring to look for on the page (for `keyword` protocol).

keyword_mode.description: Whether the keyword should be present or absent.

llm_api_key.description: Provider API key, for `llm`. Its presence picks the check mode: with a key the monitor sends the model a real one-token request and verifies the answer (`inference` — billed by the provider, requires `ai_inference_enabled` on the plan); without a key only endpoint availability is checked (`availability`, spends no tokens). On update omit the field to keep the stored key, pass `null` to delete it and fall back to availability, pass a string to replace it. Stored encrypted and never returned: responses carry only `llm_api_key_masked`.

llm_model.description: Model identifier, for `llm`. Required together with `llm_api_key` and pointless without it: with no key the check probes only endpoint availability and no model is involved.

llm_provider.description: API dialect of the endpoint. Required for `llm`. It selects the method path, auth header, body format and success marker only — the address always comes from `host`. `openai_compatible` fits OpenAI itself and the gateways that copy its API.

locations.description: Locations to run checks from. Allowed values are the codes from `current_plan_get` -> `features.available_locations`.

project_id.description: Project the monitor belongs to. Omitted on create, it goes to the oldest project of the account; passed on update, the monitor MOVES there — it starts living by the notification rules and channels of the new project and disappears from the status pages of the old one. See `project_list`.

protocol.description: Monitor type. SSL/domain checks are flags layered on top of `http`. `llm` watches an AI endpoint and is configured by the `llm_*` fields.

request_timeout.description: Request timeout in seconds. Defaults to 30, as in the panel.

success_http_codes.description: HTTP codes considered successful. Accepts exact codes (200, 301) and masks (2xx, 5xx).
